coverage: 4/4: successful main-push CI retention, development identity/config, authenticated immutable import, receipt-bound SEO native path; implementation and native proof remain pending.

prior_gaps.github_run_provenance: ADDRESSED: repository/workflow/event/ref/conclusion/head SHA/run attempt/artifact ID and GitHub archive digest are required in addition to CI tree proof.
prior_gaps.current_source_label: ADDRESSED: freshly fetched origin/main and local tracked state at import and result time prevent dirty or advanced source from inheriting a current-source claim.
prior_gaps.nested_receipt_path: ADDRESSED: strict run-qualified import and sibling receipt paths explicitly extend both helper admissions without replacing frozen .output builds.

advisory: The SEO runner currently requires manifest and receipt versions to equal the checkout package version for a development receipt. An older exact-commit artifact after a version bump will need its matching checkout or a separately scoped runner change; current-main import is unaffected.
source_checks: .github/workflows/ci.yml has a successful-build path but no upload; release.yml is a separate release-authority path; record-local-dev-build.mjs and native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs enforce absolute path/tree binding; seo-guest-acceptance.mjs accepts both overrides; WXT development key and committed public runtime config are present.
github_contract: GitHub's Actions artifact REST response exposes digest/workflow_run; upload-artifact exposes artifact ID and SHA-256 digest: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/artifacts and https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact
limits: Read-only plan reattack. No build, browser run, secret read, workflow edit, or claim that an artifact exists from this proposal.
